text_sanskrit: सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति ।वेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते ॥ १-२९ ॥
itrans: sIdanti mama gAtrANi mukha.n cha parishuShyati . vepathushcha sharIre me romaharShashcha jAyate .. 1-29 ..
translation: At seeing these my kinsmen, O Krishna, that stand up eager to fight, my limbs fail, and my mouth is parched, my body quivers and my hair stands on end;
